verses.verse:
बालानाम् तु रुचि स्तारे युवानाम् मध्य सप्तके।
प्रौणानाम् वादकानाम् तु रुचिर्मन्द्रे प्रजायते।७७।
verses.text: Children take delight in the high register, the young in the middle octave; and in mature players the delight arises in the low [register].

commentary.text: That is, children like a bānsurī of the tāra (high) octave, young people one of the madhya (middle) octave, and mature people one of the mandra (low) octave.

subsection.title: Practice of the Tongue and of the Fingers
